definitions.gloss: luxury item; luxury goods; non-essential item
definitions.explanation: An expensive or extravagant item that is not a necessity but a desirable indulgence. Contrasted with daily necessities.

examples.japanese: {贅沢品|ぜいたくひん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{買|か}わない→買う：00489_kau⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I try not to buy luxury items.

examples.japanese: ⟦ブランド→ブランド：05221_burando⟧⟦バッグ→バッグ：00008_baggu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{贅沢品|ぜいたくひん}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think brand-name bags are luxury goods.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦時中|せんじちゅう}→戦時中：28629_senjichuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{贅沢品|ぜいたくひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦{必需品|ひつじゅひん}→必需品：15541_hitsujuhin⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: During wartime, the sale of luxury goods was restricted, and only daily necessities were available.

notes:
{贅沢品|ぜいたくひん} is a compound of ⟦{贅沢|ぜいたく}→贅沢：03309_zeitaku⟧ (luxury, extravagance) + ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (goods). It refers to non-essential, expensive items — things you want but don't need.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {贅沢品|ぜいたくひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (to buy luxury goods)
- {贅沢品|ぜいたくひん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ (to tax luxury goods)
- {贅沢品|ぜいたくひん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{必需品|ひつじゅひん}→必需品：15541_hitsujuhin⟧ (luxuries and necessities)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{必需品|ひつじゅひん}→必需品：15541_hitsujuhin⟧: necessities, essential goods
- ⟦{日用品|にちようひん}→日用品：09547_nichiyouhin⟧: daily goods, everyday items
- ⟦{高級品|こうきゅうひん}→高級品：21439_koukyuuhin⟧: high-quality goods (emphasizes quality, not extravagance)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Historically, ⟦{贅沢|ぜいたく}→贅沢：03309_zeitaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧だ (luxury is the enemy) was a wartime slogan. The concept of restraining luxury spending has deep roots in Japanese culture.
